title: C4109B — Rear subwoofer amplifier connector
introduction:
I use this reference as the rear subwoofer amplifier plug’s seating chart: a cavity can have a place in the housing without having a wire assigned to it. Start with the connector identification table, use the drawing to locate a cavity label, then find that label in the assignment table.

The assigned rows distinguish the rear-subwoofer connections by color, but their shared function description does not establish polarity or speaker pairing. Asterisks remain unspecified entries, not electrical values. This page supports reading the map and its service-parts listing; it does not teach access, probing, testing or replacement. Physical viewing direction, gauge convention and metadata-code definitions are unspecified, so do not turn those fields into installation or wire-selection instructions.

edits.why: I use the housing outline and its projecting feature on the left to keep track of the drawing’s orientation on the page. The outlined cavities run down the right; the shaded cavities sit on the left. Those shaded positions correspond to rows without circuit or function assignments. This describes the printed view without assuming whether the physical connector is viewed from its wire side or mating side.

The cavity label is the bridge between drawing and table. Read across its row to keep color, function and the remaining fields attached to the same position. The Used column agrees with the distinction between assigned and unassigned rows. Neither a blank entry nor an asterisk supplies a missing circuit identity, wire specification or test result.

The Engineering Shell entry connects the pigtail listing with the Hard Shell and Fpn identification above. Service Part identifies the listed service item; Terminal Part Number belongs to individual assignment rows. Keep those roles separate, and keep the pigtail Gauge entry separate from the unspecified gauges in the circuit table. This is a parts cross-reference, not a replacement decision or splice procedure.
